verified.name: validation-populated-pnpm-dependencies
verified.evidence_required: vibe-supervisor validation prepare on a representative project with a populated pnpm store: exact Node and manager pins, frozen lockfile, dependencies inside the owned copies, hooks, lifecycle scripts and fetches off, explicit blockers for unsupported profiles, source preserved and cleanup refusal shown.
verified.evidence: 2026-10-15, preparing machine (macOS arm64), Node v20.19.0 from nvm, pnpm 9.15.4 installed into that Node: vibe-supervisor validation prepare on a public fixture (two registry dependencies, exact packageManager pin, pnpm-lock.yaml v9) with a pnpm store populated beforehand. Prepared with dependencies installed inside both owned copies and no link resolving outside the validation root; the manifest records Node v20.19.0, pnpm 9.15.4, the base commit, the patch and lockfile hashes. Lifecycle scripts stayed off: with a preinstall exiting 97 and a postinstall exiting 99 the preparation still succeeded. The source checkout stayed clean at its base. Cleanup removed an untouched workspace and retained a changed one (also after a git checkout restore, which rewrites the copy's index). Unsupported profiles (file:, link:, workspace:, git dependencies, requiresBuild, hasInstallScript) are blocked by unit tests. The first run found a defect: the lockfile check matched excludeLinksFromLockfile, present in every pnpm 9 lockfile, so every populated pnpm project was blocked; fixed with regression tests before this pass.

delivery_requirements.stable_promotion: Every gate above, exact final source/archive identity, applicable confirmation and separate merge/tag/publication authorization remain required. The release publishes the bytes the target tested; no receipt or result of the workflow candidate, the 2.0.0 draft archive, the reference package or the rejected packet transfers. Only the latest release is supported.
